mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( login_id, email, password_hash, nickname, region, birth_date, phone_number, introduction, created_at ) VALUES ( #{loginId}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{region}, #{birthDate}, #{phoneNumber}, #{introduction}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, nickname = #{nickname}, region = #{region}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, introduction = #{introduction} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, email, password_hash, nickname, region, birth_date, phone_number, introduction, created_at FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
